stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: Mike Whelan on top with 38 pts - the field is chasing like Brisbane chased Sydney: from a long way back

stories.title: Someone Call Security
stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 1 & 17 - the handicapper has questions

stories.title: Nailbiter
stories.detail: one point splits the top two - down to the wire

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 184 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: Relatively Good Golf
stories.detail: Gabrielle and Angus Bolton both up the board - must be something in the water at home

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - 1 off the pace

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Great to have you with us, Stephen Martin from Duntryleague GC. Enjoy your round and the 19th afterwards.

stories.title: Low-Marker Masterclass
stories.detail: Off the stick (1) and 6th - proper ball-striking

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 17 & 18 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: Turn for the Better
stories.detail: Caught fire at the turn - 9 across 9, 10 & 11

stories.title: Front-Runner
stories.detail: Front nine 22, back nine 12 - the tank hit empty

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Two's Company
stories.detail: 3-pointers on holes 13 & 14 - this is momentum

stories.title: Under the Radar
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers+ through the round - not flashy, just effective

stories.title: Bounce-Back Merchant
stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: Short Memory
stories.detail: 2 wipes, every one followed by a score - forgets fast

stories.title: One Step Forward...
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 16, 1-pointer on hole 17

stories.title: Rough Patch
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 17 & 18 - club still in the bag

stories.title: Nothing But Ones
stories.detail: 7 1-pointers, zero wipes - zero wipes is something to hang your hat on

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 12, 13 & 14

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 9, 10 & 11 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Rock Solid
stories.detail: Zero wipes and 6 two-pointers - boring in the best way

stories.title: Not Today, Scoreboard
stories.detail: 4 wipes from 16 holes - the scorecard is mostly fresh air

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 1, 2 & 3 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Caught at the Post
stories.detail: Led most of the day, run down to 5th at the death

stories.title: Footy Form Guide
stories.detail: Michael McCormack on 21 pts - a no-show worthy of the Lions' Saturday-night tape

comingLast.roast: 21 points - his phone is off, his mates made sure of it
4 points to safety - his back nine just became the main event
at 1.3 a hole the suspense is entirely one-sided
5 points over 6 holes to escape - the maths is doable, the golf is the question
he can still pass McCormack - stranger things have happened, rarely to him
in the clubhouse 5 above McCormack - cheering for him from a safe distance
